CustomField.label: Invoice Number Method (Financial System)
CustomField.description: How the financial system (Exact) gives an invoice its number. Import: the number exists when the invoice is created (import); Print: Exact assigns it when the invoice is printed. Blank: no financial system. Set per entity; UK = Import, NL and DE = Print.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Import = the financial system numbers the invoice on create. Print = it numbers it on print. Blank = no financial system.
